conventions.data: ECB/Frankfurter daily reference rates (MetaTrader 5 D1 closes when the terminal offers FX symbols — it currently does not). All triggers and resolutions are CLOSE-based.
conventions.watching: A directional setup published in a report whose trigger has not yet fired. Watches only closes strictly after the report session.
conventions.open: Trigger fired: entry = the first qualifying daily close, entryDate = that session. Open tickets are never modified by later reports.

resolution.target: A daily close at/beyond the target level closes the ticket with outcome 'target'.
resolution.stop: A daily close at/beyond the stop level closes the ticket with outcome 'stop' (realized R = -1).
resolution.expired: 10 sessions after entry with neither level close-crossed closes the ticket with outcome 'expired'; realized R is computed from the 10th-session close.

conventions.realizedR: long: (exit - entry) / (entry - stop); short: (entry - exit) / (stop - entry). Exit = the closing session's close.
conventions.oneTicketPerPair: A new report replaces the pair's existing 'watching' ticket (never an 'open' one).
conventions.legacyNote: Tickets seeded from the 14/08/2026 report predate the mechanical-trigger rule (17/08/2026); their triggerRule fields record the close-based proxy used for them.
conventions.revoked: A watching ticket withdrawn by a later report before its trigger fired (e.g. levels re-priced on the current data basis); realized R is null.
